subject: general
question: The 'Handball at School' initiative launched in 2025 to promote handball at the grassroots level in India is a collaboration between which organisations?

options.text: International Handball Federation and Asian Handball Federation
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and National Handball Federation
All India School Sports Federation and Handball Association of India
Indian Olympic Association and Sports Authority of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Handball Federation and Asian Handball Federation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Handball at School' initiative** was launched in **2025** to promote the sport of handball at the grassroots level in **India**.
 
• The initiative is a joint collaboration between the **International Handball Federation (IHF)** and the **Asian Handball Federation (AHF)**. Both organizations have been actively working to promote handball globally and regionally.
 
• The program emphasizes introducing handball to school children, providing training to coaches and physical education teachers, and supporting infrastructure development. *Hence, the correct answer is International Handball Federation and Asian Handball Federation.*
 
• The **Asian Handball Federation** is the governing body for handball in Asia and works under the umbrella of the **International Handball Federation** to strengthen the sport across the continent.
 
• The initiative aligns with the global vision of promoting handball as an inclusive and accessible sport for young people.
 
• Through this collaboration, the program aims to improve handball's popularity in India, which has immense potential in sports development at the school and community levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Handball Federation (IHF):**

 
 
• **Established in 1946**, the IHF is the global governing body for the sport of handball.
 
• It oversees handball competitions worldwide, including the **World Handball Championships** and other international tournaments.
 
• The IHF also provides funding and technical support to member federations to promote the sport.
 
 
 
• **Asian Handball Federation (AHF):**
 
 
• The AHF is the regional governing body for handball in Asia, established in **1974**.
 
• It works to promote handball in Asian countries, organize regional tournaments, and support the development of handball infrastructure.
 
• The AHF collaborates with the IHF on initiatives like **'Handball at School'** to ensure the sport reaches a broader audience.
 
 
 
• **Handball in India:**
 
 
• Handball is an emerging sport in India, with efforts being made to popularize it among the youth.
 
• Programs like the 'Handball at School' initiative aim to identify and nurture young talent in schools and communities.
 
• The **Handball Federation of India** works closely with international and regional organizations to promote the sport nationally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Objectives of the 'Handball at School' Initiative:**

 
 
• To introduce handball as a sport to children at an early age and encourage participation in schools.
 
• To train physical education teachers and coaches in schools with the help of resources provided by the IHF and AHF.
 
• To develop handball infrastructure such as courts and equipment in schools and communities.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact:**
 
 
• The 'Handball at School' initiative is a part of the IHF's global strategy to make handball one of the most widely played sports worldwide.
 
• Similar programs have been implemented in other countries, leading to increased participation in international tournaments.
